limitations: This register freezes the scanner-visible source callsite set and records manual resolution notes for computed event expressions; it is not a projection manifest, event allowlist, payload schema, authorization policy or runtime enforcement.
All literal event types remain unclassified pending query-by-query reader/writer analysis.
Unbounded public event parameters remain unresolved even where observed internal callers are listed.
Configured-entrypoint imports do not establish deployed process/worker/shared-database reachability.

The direct-SQL event-writer supplement currently records two confirmed INSERT callsites outside recordEvent(); it is not a complete scan of all possible direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, aliases, generated SQL, wrappers or non-SQL event stores.

directSqlEventWriters.note: Direct SQL insert; not a recordEvent() callsite. Existing row is checked before insert and exact row is read back after insert. Enclosing transaction/caller contract must be traced separately.
directSqlEventWriters.writerBindingEvidence: run(eventId, jobId, APPROVAL_POLICY_OBSERVED_EVENT, JSON.stringify(payload), new Date(now).toISOString())
directSqlEventWriters.readbackEvidence: const persisted = workflowDb.prepare('SELECT event_id,job_id,type,payload_json FROM events WHERE event_id=?').get(eventId);

readerQueries.purpose: reconstruct policy high-water and reject malformed/reused versions
readerQueries.querySourceEvidence:
SELECT event_id,job_id,type,payload_json FROM events
    WHERE type=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.policy_id')=? ORDER BY rowid ASC

directSqlEventWriters.note: Direct SQL insert; not a recordEvent() callsite. Writer performs nonce precheck, inserts canonical serialized attestation, verifies/readbacks exact current source binding and execution-review readiness before caller transaction commits; invalid verification throws and rolls back caller transaction.
directSqlEventWriters.writerBindingEvidence: run(eventId, jobId, ADAPTIVE_GOAL_REVIEWER_ATTESTATION_EVENT, serialized, new Date(now).toISOString())
directSqlEventWriters.readbackEvidence: const verified = assertAdaptiveGoalReviewerAttestation(store, jobId, candidate, { now, trustConfigurationDb });

readerQueries.purpose: load exactly one reviewer attestation for the candidate job
readerQueries.querySourceEvidence:
SELECT event_id,job_id,type,payload_json FROM events
    WHERE job_id=? AND type=? ORDER BY created_at ASC,rowid ASC

readerQueries.purpose: require exactly one durable use of the reviewer attestation nonce
readerQueries.querySourceEvidence:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM events
    WHERE type=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.nonce')=?

reviewNote: Append-only v0.5.13 successor after introducing Workflow Plan API v1 as a stable host-facing facade for canonicalJson and authoritative validateExecutionPlan. AGG candidate, readiness, reviewed-input, approval, reviewer, action-intent binding and sandbox modules now consume that facade plus the root Agent Contracts public API; they no longer import private workflow/plan.js or workflow/agent-contracts.js modules. The new workflow-plan-public-api.js contributes zero RecordEvent callsites. No source files were removed. All 114 callsite tuples preserve file, job-id argument, event-type expression, classification and literal value; no callsite was added or removed. All 17 computed-producer resolution objects remain byte-for-byte equivalent and line keys are unchanged. Counts remain 97 literal, 17 computed/unresolved and 71 distinct literal event types. The source inventory now covers 107 runtime/entrypoint files. The Workflow Plan API is a stable in-monorepo dependency facade, not a separate repository, database, process or release.
